_about: Host-country corpus structure (DOCX §7.3 — India-specific corpus categories).
Records which DOCX corpus categories are covered, which sources satisfy them,
and which categories are currently unavailable or only partially covered.
All source metadata is drawn from knowledge_base/sources/manifest.json.
Chunk counts are drawn from knowledge_base/ingestion_manifest.json.
Nothing is fabricated: unavailable sources and missing categories are explicitly marked.
note_on_scope: This corpus covers India (host-country). International standards (3GPP, ITU, ETSI, NIST) are separate reference material assigned to the Technical, Standards, and Cybersecurity KBs.

categories.description: Primary legislation and subordinate rules with direct force in India relevant to 5G networks.
categories.coverage_status: PARTIAL — key legislation ingested; NCIIPC Rules unavailable

sources_ingested.title: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997 (as amended, TDSAT compilation)
The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
CERT-In Directions under s.70B of IT Act 2000 (28 April 2022)

sources_unavailable.title: IT (NCIIPC) Rules 2013
sources_unavailable.reason: IndiaCode returned HTTP 504; NCIIPC website unresponsive at retrieval time
sources_unavailable.impact: Critical Infrastructure KB cannot confirm NCIIPC designation criteria or operator obligations to NCIIPC. Claims citing this instrument will be UNSUPPORTED.

sources_not_yet_considered: Indian Telegraph Act, 1885 (parent of TRAI Act; foundational but not separately ingested)
Information Technology Act, 2000 (parent of CERT-In Directions; not separately ingested)
DoT licence conditions and subordinate directions (not ingested)

categories.description: Statutory and regulatory mandates of the key institutions responsible for 5G governance in India.
categories.coverage_status: PARTIAL — TRAI mandate ingested; NCIIPC mandate unavailable; DoT mandate partially via Telecom Act

institutions_and_coverage.coverage: INGESTED (18 chunks) — Directions only; founding CERT-In mandate under IT Act not separately ingested

institutions_and_coverage.institution: National Critical Information Infrastructure Protection Centre (NCIIPC)
Telecom Disputes Settlement and Appellate Tribunal (TDSAT)
institutions_and_coverage.coverage: INGESTED (78 chunks, shared with TRAI Act)

categories.description: India's telecom market structure, 5G deployment economics, infrastructure investment landscape.
categories.coverage_status: NOT COVERED — no dedicated source ingested
categories.note: Policy documents (NDCP 2018, TRAI recommendations) contain some economic objectives but no dedicated economic/industrial-characteristics source was ingested. This is a known gap. The DOCX does not specify a required source for this category.

categories.description: Workforce capacity, skills availability, and labour-market conditions relevant to 5G deployment and operation.
categories.note: No dedicated labour-market or skills-gap source was ingested. The DOCX does not specify a required source for this category. Out of scope for the core policy/legal analysis scenarios.

categories.description: IP regime relevant to 5G standards, licensing, and technology transfer in India.
categories.coverage_status: NOT COVERED — no dedicated source ingested
categories.note: No dedicated intellectual-property source was ingested. FRAND licensing obligations and SEP frameworks are not addressed in any ingested document. The DOCX does not specify a required source for this category.

categories.description: India's international treaty commitments relevant to telecommunications and data governance.
categories.coverage_status: NOT COVERED — no dedicated treaty instrument ingested
categories.note: No treaty texts were ingested. ITU-T Y.3172 (ingested as a standards reference) reflects ITU membership obligations but is not a treaty instrument itself. WTO GATS commitments and ITU Radio Regulations are not in the corpus.

categories.description: Energy consumption requirements, infrastructure-sharing obligations, and environmental constraints for 5G deployment.
categories.coverage_status: NOT COVERED — no dedicated source ingested
categories.note: No energy or infrastructure-constraints source was ingested. The DOCX does not specify a required source for this category. Some infrastructure-sharing provisions exist in the Telecommunications Act 2023 and are incidentally covered in the 105 ingested chunks.

categories.description: Policy and regulatory instruments from neighbouring countries and global leaders in 5G governance, used as reference points by the Policy Gap Agent.
categories.coverage_status: NOT COVERED — comparator instruments not ingested

sources_unavailable.reason: The DOCX states exact instruments 'must be added to final manifest' but names none; instrument selection is a team decision.
sources_unavailable.impact: The Policy Gap Agent cannot retrieve international comparators. It notes their absence when raising potential gaps.

corpus_summary.note_on_chunk_counts: Chunks per source are as recorded in knowledge_base/ingestion_manifest.json. The canonical KB total (4744) differs from the sum above because some chunks appear in multiple KBs and the ingestion manifest counts them once per KB assignment.
